comment: Defects found in this repository's own skills and installer.

bugs.title: chat-interrupt-plugin has no file-list function in build-release.sh, so every release tarball omits it entirely
bugs.reproduce: ./installer/build-release.sh --list | grep chat-interrupt-plugin   # prints nothing, on master before this fix
bugs.observed: installer/build-release.sh's collect() calls tui_hint_plugin_files, editor_gate_plugin_files, agent_identity_plugin_files and decision_reminder_plugin_files, but has no chat_interrupt_plugin_files equivalent and never adds chat-interrupt-plugin to the tarball at all, despite the plugin riding unconditionally with the chat skill via src/installer/src/plugins.rs's install_chat_interrupt_plugin_claude. A tarball-based (curl|bash) install of the chat skill therefore installs a chat-interrupt-plugin with zero files on disk, the same silent no-op failure mode the comment above tui_hint_plugin_files/editor_gate_plugin_files already warns about for those two plugins.
bugs.expected: build-release.sh ships chat-interrupt-plugin's own PROD files (.claude-plugin/plugin.json, hooks/hooks.json, hooks/lib.sh, hooks/pre-tool-use.sh) in every tarball, the same as its four sibling plugins.
bugs.mechanism: git log -p -- installer/build-release.sh shows chat_interrupt_plugin_files() never existed; the plugin was introduced (commit 4fa7c055) without ever being wired into collect(). The npm package was unaffected: package.json lists chat-interrupt-plugin as a bare files-array directory entry, which ships the whole directory regardless of this gap -- only the GitHub release tarball path was ever broken, which is why it went uncaught.
bugs.found_by: claude-sonnet-5-5, alpha.6 release prep -- discovered auditing test-rjq-active-references.sh's npm-package-baseline failure, which led to a wider packaging-manifest check
bugs.notes: Second, smaller instance of the same gap found in the same pass: editor-gate-plugin/hooks/pre-tool-use-read.sh is similarly missing from editor_gate_plugin_files() AND from src/installer/src/plugins.rs's EDITOR_GATE_PLUGIN_FILES constant (filed separately). A dedicated general-purpose sub-agent is auditing the rest of the repo for the same class of gap; its findings, if any, should be filed as follow-ups rather than folded into this entry.

bugs.title: editor-gate-plugin's Read-matcher hook (pre-tool-use-read.sh) has never been installed by any install path
bugs.reproduce: install editor-gate-plugin via either a tarball-based install or a direct dev-tree install (./target/release/installer install-skill ... --source .); then ls <target>/editor-gate-plugin/hooks/pre-tool-use-read.sh
bugs.observed: The file does not exist on disk despite hooks.json's own Read matcher wiring 'bash ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pre-tool-use-read.sh': it is marked MODE: PROD, genuinely needed, and was missing from both installer/build-release.sh's editor_gate_plugin_files() (the tarball manifest) and src/installer/src/plugins.rs's EDITOR_GATE_PLUGIN_FILES constant (what the compiled installer itself actually copies) -- so no install path, tarball or npm-sourced, ever delivered it. The Read-only soft reminder hook has silently never functioned for any installed copy of this plugin.
bugs.expected: editor-gate-plugin's Read hook installs and fires like its Bash/Edit/Write siblings.
bugs.mechanism: Confirmed both lists lacked the entry; EDITOR_GATE_PLUGIN_EXECUTABLES also lacked it, so even if the file had been present it would not have been marked executable.
bugs.found_by: claude-sonnet-5-5, alpha.6 release prep -- found auditing B1 (chat-interrupt-plugin's own missing tarball entry)
